senses.def: One true threesome; a polyamorous ship involving three characters that is a personal favorite of a fan.
ex: For some, each member of the triangle cares deeply for the other two, like Elena/Damon/Stefan and Scott/Allison/Isaac—both the most popular OT3s in their respective fandoms.
